# boodoo Framework — LLM Summary & Documentation Index

> boodoo is a modular, mobile-first, responsive CSS design framework inspired by Bootstrap, Foundation, Tailwind CSS, and Material Design. It ships as Sass/LESS source, compiled CSS, vanilla JS components, and an npm package with a CDN-ready build.

## Project Details
- Website: https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com
- License: MIT
- Author: Pebble Benders
- Architecture: Sass/LESS modular architecture, BEM class syntax, Flexbox & CSS Grid systems, Vanilla JS components with zero external runtime dependencies.

## CDN Links
- Combined CSS Bundle: `https://cdn.dihadiwala.com/s/app_299a167f351ab3de/2026/09/boodoo.min-86cc87a5.css`
- JavaScript Component Library: `https://cdn.dihadiwala.com/s/app_299a167f351ab3de/2026/09/boodoo.min-19c7b3bc.js`
- Flexbox Grid Bundle: `https://cdn.dihadiwala.com/s/app_299a167f351ab3de/2026/09/boodoo-grid.min-00656288.css`
- Reboot/Reset Base CSS: `https://cdn.dihadiwala.com/s/app_299a167f351ab3de/2026/09/boodoo-reboot.min-bac848f1.css`
- Utility Classes CSS: `https://cdn.dihadiwala.com/s/app_299a167f351ab3de/2026/09/boodoo-utilities.min-10ded7df.css`
- CSS Micro-Animations: `https://cdn.dihadiwala.com/s/app_299a167f351ab3de/2026/09/boodoo-animations.min-c91f69bf.css`

## Documentation Pages Index

### Getting Started
- [Introduction](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/introduction.html): Overview, core philosophy, and setup basics.
- [Download](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/download.html): Downloads for compiled assets and source packages.
- [What's Included](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/contents.html): Directory breakdown of compiled dist and source files.
- [Usage & CDN](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/usage.html): Including boodoo via CDN scripts and links.
- [NPM Installation](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/npm.html): Installing and referencing boodoo in Node projects.
- [Sass Customization](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/sass.html): Overriding Sass variables, maps, and compiling.
- [Less Customization](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/less.html): Overriding Less variables and compiling.
- [Starter Template](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/starter.html): Ready-to-use HTML template structure.
- [Browser Support](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/browser-support.html): Supported browsers and target compatibility.
- [Accessibility](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/getting-started/accessibility.html): ARIA attributes, keyboard focus management, and WCAG compliance.

### Layout & Grid System
- [Containers](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/layout/containers.html): Fixed and responsive container wrappers (`.container`, `.container-fluid`).
- [Grid System](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/layout/grid.html): 12-column flexbox grid system (`.row`, `.col-*`).
- [Columns](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/layout/columns.html): Alignment, ordering, offsets, and nesting.
- [Gutters](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/layout/gutters.html): Horizontal and vertical spacing between columns (`.g-*`, `.gx-*`, `.gy-*`).
- [CSS Grid](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/layout/css-grid.html): Native CSS Grid layout helpers (`.grid`, `.g-col-*`).
- [Breakpoints](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/layout/breakpoints.html): Media query ranges (`sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `xxl`).

### Content & Typography
- [Typography](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/content/typography.html): Headings, body copy, lead text, blockquotes, inline text styles.
- [Images](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/content/images.html): Responsive images (`.img-fluid`), thumbnails, and alignment.
- [Tables](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/content/tables.html): Striped, bordered, hoverable, and responsive tables.
- [Figures](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/content/figures.html): Captioned images and media figure elements.

### Form Components
- [Overview](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/overview.html): Form layout and structure principles.
- [Form Control](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/form-control.html): Text inputs, textareas, file inputs, and sizing.
- [Select](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/select.html): Custom styled native `<select>` controls.
- [Checks & Radios](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/checks.html): Custom checkboxes, radio buttons, and toggle switches.
- [Range](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/range.html): Custom range sliders and dual-thumb range sliders.
- [Input Group](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/input-group.html): Prepend and append text, buttons, or dropdowns to inputs.
- [Floating Labels](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/floating-labels.html): Animated floating text labels over inputs.
- [OTP & PIN Input](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/otp.html): Dedicated digit input boxes with auto-advance and paste splitting.
- [Dropzone](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/dropzone.html): Drag-and-drop file upload containers, file list items, and upload progress.
- [Pickers (Color & Date)](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/pickers.html): Enhanced color picker wrappers with hex badges and date/time groups.
- [Validation](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/forms/validation.html): Server-side and client-side form validation feedback.

### UI Components
- [Accordion](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/accordion.html): Collapsible text panels.
- [Alerts](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/alerts.html): Contextual notification banners.
- [Avatar](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/avatar.html): User profile images and placeholder badges.
- [Badge](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/badge.html): Small count, notification dot, and labeling indicators.
- [Bottom Sheet](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/bottom-sheet.html): Mobile-first touch-draggable drawer with physics.
- [Breadcrumb](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/breadcrumb.html): Hierarchy navigation trails.
- [Buttons](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/buttons.html): Button variants, sizes, states, and outlines.
- [Button Group](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/button-group.html): Grouped button toolbars and split buttons.
- [Card](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/card.html): Flexible content containers with headers, footers, and images.
- [Carousel](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/carousel.html): Image and content slideshow component.
- [Chips & Tag Input](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/chip.html): Compact removable pills and interactive dynamic tag input containers.
- [Collapse](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/collapse.html): Toggle visibility of content blocks.
- [Command Palette](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/command-palette.html): Global Spotlight-style fuzzy search and keyboard action runner.
- [Context Menu](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/context-menu.html): Right-click floating menu with collision protection and shortcuts.
- [Data Table](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/data-table.html): Sortable columns, select-all checkboxes, expandable details, and dense sizing.
- [Dropdowns](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/dropdowns.html): Contextual menu overlays.
- [Empty State](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/empty-state.html): Placeholders for zero-data screens, 404s, and search misses.
- [Kbd](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/kbd.html): Tactile 3D shortcut keycaps and key combinations.
- [List Group](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/list-group.html): Flexible list item containers.
- [Modal](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/modal.html): Dialog overlays and popups.
- [Native Components](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/native.html): Operating-system specific platform tokens (Fluent, macOS, HIG, Material).
- [Navs & Tabs](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/navs.html): Navigation tabs, pills, and tabbed content panes.
- [Navbar](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/navbar.html): Responsive header navigation bars.
- [Offcanvas](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/offcanvas.html): Slide-over sidebars for mobile navigation and filters.
- [Pagination](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/pagination.html): Page navigation links.
- [Placeholders](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/placeholder.html): Skeleton loading indicators.
- [Popovers](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/popovers.html): Rich content tooltips.
- [Progress](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/progress.html): Progress bars and stacked progress indicators.
- [Rating](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/rating.html): Interactive and read-only star rating controls.
- [Scrollspy](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/scrollspy.html): Automatically update nav links based on scroll position.
- [Segmented Control](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/segmented-control.html): Apple-style segmented pill toggles and blocks.
- [Sidebar](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/sidebar.html): Multi-level collapsible desktop navigation sidebar.
- [Skeleton](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/skeleton.html): Shimmer animation placeholders for content cards and avatars.
- [Spinners](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/spinners.html): Loading spinners and dots.
- [Stepper](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/stepper.html): Multi-step wizard workflows and checkout progress trackers.
- [Timeline](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/timeline.html): Activity streams and chronological audit logs.
- [Toasts](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/toasts.html): Push notification popups and helper API.
- [Tooltips](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/tooltips.html): Lightweight hover popups.
- [Tree View](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/tree-view.html): Hierarchical folder structures and expandable file trees.
- [Ripple Effect](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/components/ripple.html): Material Design touch dynamic ripple effect.

### Helpers & Utilities
- [Clearfix](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/helpers/clearfix.html): Clearing floated elements.
- [Ratio](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/helpers/ratio.html): Aspect ratio wrappers (16:9, 4:3, 1:1).
- [Visually Hidden](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/helpers/visually-hidden.html): Screen-reader accessible hidden text.
- [Stretched Link](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/helpers/stretched-link.html): Expanding link click area to containing card/box.
- [Color & Background](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/helpers/color-bg.html): Theme color helper utilities.
- [Elevation](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/helpers/elevation.html): Material design depth shadows (`.elevation-1` to `.elevation-5`).
- [Spacing](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/utilities/spacing.html): Margin and padding utilities (`.m-*`, `.p-*`).
- [Flexbox](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/utilities/flex.html): Flex container and item placement utilities.

### Motion & Animations
- [Animations](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/motion/animations.html): Entrance and exit micro-animations (`.anim-fade-in`, `.anim-slide-up`, `.anim-bounce`).
- [Transitions](https://boodoo.dihadiwala.com/docs/motion/transitions.html): Smooth CSS property transition utilities.
